subject.title: fix(gateway): connect first-boot loopback agents after readiness

question: Should runtime-token loopback startup automatically persist an admin-capable token for the canonical same-user CLI identity before readiness?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes when an authenticated operator credential is created and stored; source evidence shows it preserves existing scoped-token limits, but the acceptable same-user trust boundary is a maintainer security-policy decision.

options.title: Confirm same-user loopback pairing
options.body: Approve the automatic canonical CLI pairing as the intended local trust model after removing the release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Require a narrower trust model
options.body: Pause the PR and redesign the startup path if persistent admin credentials must require an explicit pairing or operator action even on loopback.

recommendation.title: Confirm same-user loopback pairing
recommendation.body: Approve the automatic canonical CLI pairing as the intended local trust model after removing the release-owned changelog edit.

likelyOwner.reason: The reporter and current patch author has the strongest available context for the reproduced startup and credential flow, although broader code-history attribution could not be completed.
